info.title: wwm
info.summary: Windows WSL Manager — collect, restore, New WSL, and named software profiles
info.description: JSON on stdout for agent commands. Errors on stderr. Interactive TUI when a command is run with no subcommand flags that imply JSON.

commands.name: collect
commands.description: Scan this PC and write a kit to a non-system drive

commands.name: restore
commands.description: Install from a kit (optional path)

arguments.name: kit
arguments.description: Path to a kit folder or KIT.json

commands.name: new-wsl
commands.description: Create a supported distro. blank = user + passwordless sudo only; home/work also run install.sh

options.name: --profile
options.description: Linux profile: blank | home | work | custom id

options.name: --distro
options.description: Create target or alias (ubuntu, debian, arch, kali, fedora, alma, opensuse, oracle)

options.name: --location
options.description: Install the VHDX on this folder (not C:)

commands.name: distros
commands.description: JSON: supported ∩ wsl --list --online, plus installed and default

commands.name: distro
commands.description: List, sync Terminal, move, clone, or unregister a distro

commands.name: list
commands.description: Same JSON as `wwm distros`

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Refresh Windows Terminal. Does not overwrite Microsoft.WSL command lines

commands.name: move
commands.description: wsl --manage --move. Not C:. Any installed distro, including Pengwin.

commands.name: clone
commands.description: Export VHD and import as a new name. Not C: unless --location is elsewhere.

options.name: --location
options.description: Install folder for the clone (not C:)

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Unregister a distro (deletes the disk) and drop leftover WWM Terminal tabs

commands.name: profiles
commands.description: Edit / suggest / apply a named software profile

commands.name: list
commands.description: JSON of bundles, linux, and windows profiles

commands.name: show
commands.description: JSON for one profile id

commands.name: new
commands.description: Create a user profile from a shipped one

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add linux tools and/or windows packages

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove linux tools and/or windows packages

commands.name: tui
commands.description: Same as `wwm profiles` with no subcommand

commands.name: catalog
commands.description: Shipped linux and/or windows catalog JSON

arguments.name: which
arguments.description: linux, windows, or omit for both

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search linux catalog or winget

commands.name: map
commands.description: Linux equivalent for a winget id (preferLinux)

commands.name: suggest
commands.description: Draft a profile from what this PC has installed

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Install a bundle. blank installs no Windows apps and skips Homebrew

commands.name: inventory
commands.description: JSON snapshot of this PC (kit-shaped, no write)

commands.name: spec
commands.description: Print this OpenCLI description (JSON) on stdout
